spiritgiven.comments: Team adjusted with body contacts. Greatly appreciate the cheers on the sideline and the spirit captain and captain.
Body contacts were only adjusted until the latter part of the 2nd half but still greatly appreciate the spirit captains and captains helping to communicate with us and to the rest of their team.
Thank you for the fun game
Couple of contact on markers and hands on defender while running. Captains helping to communicate to specific players.
Settled during huddle with captains use of foul language and hand checks on cutters
For us the most spirited team on and off the field

Thank you for the intense but spirited game. 
Greatly appreciate the adjustments coming from the first match-up. Go SEA!
Thank you for the experience playing against USA.

spiritreceived.comments: Thanks for the lovely game, thanks for bringing to our attention the body contact, we will focus on making sure we improve :)

Spirit captains told us we were making a lot of body contact and said that they would have called contact or fouls on plays. We often felt like contact was matched and in some instances initiated by the other team, so we tried but werent sure how to adjust. Overall a good game; would just appreciate calls to be made or specific examples to be given so that we can pinpoint what kind of contact was too much and so that we can adjust in the future!

There were instances where calls were made in a manner favourable to their team for e.g calling a foul on the throw after a turnover has occurred but not immediately after throw was made or instances of sidelines urging players to make calls
We can both work on even better communication e.g. to have the same understanding that we expect a no contact game and remain receptive to each other :)
Both sides worked on the feedback that was given and it really showed through in this game. We really appreciate it. Kudos to our SEA comrades for the win! :)

We really appreciated their willingness to talk through our differences from yesterday and learn from each other and thought that the spirit captain communication was very good. However, as a team, we felt that the number of calls at critical moments in the game far exceeded the average number of calls which made it hard to play.
